exact_claim_text: Within this bounded synthetic case, workflow integration depended on explicit remediation ownership and exception handling more than on alert generation alone.
method_or_source: Triangulation across configuration snapshots, issue records, meeting notes, policy documents and illustrative interviews, including discrepant evidence.
uncertainty: Incomplete organisational records, retrospective accounts, researcher access and the uniqueness of the case context.
boundary: One synthetic laboratory, one 12-week period and one workflow; analytic, not statistical, generalisation.
counter_evidence: Illustrative synthesis only: scanning became routine only after remediation ownership and exception handling were assigned. Alert volume alone did not explain uptake; one project bypassed the control when responsibility remained ambiguous.
stronger_wording_rejected: Automated dependency scanning succeeds whenever a tool is enabled.
